_comment: NeurHL Tier-2 config #4 (ledger gm-c4, AMENDMENT A2). Adds the pre-game v1 Elo logit as a context feature so the network learns the RESIDUAL rather than rediscovering team strength from roster composition (R.2 proved it cannot). Keeps A1 team form + reduced capacity + 2008 corpus; RESTORES the preregistered temporal adjacent-season validation (config #3's i.i.d. holdout was shown to reward team-season memorisation). Headline criterion is the new gate S1: paired significance vs v1 at p<0.05. No threshold anywhere is relaxed.
early_stop: rolling-origin val within tune window, patience 10
calibration: temperature_on_outcome4, fit in train window only
